name: Landmine Press
instructions: Wedge one end of a barbell into a landmine base.
Hold the free end at shoulder height with one or both hands.
Press up and slightly forward to full extension.
Lower with control. Shoulder-friendly pressing with a natural arc.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: A beginner barbell press-pattern exercise targeting the front delts. Landmine Press builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
